---
title: "Labs"
---

Labs referenced by the Crossplane course. Course-scoped labs live under
`courses/crossplane/labs/`; reusable labs shared with other courses live
under the repository-root [`labs/`](../../../labs/index.html) directory.

## Referenced labs

- [Hello Pico](../../../labs/hello-pico/) — the introductory Pico lab
  from the [Pico course](../../pico/index.html). Produces the
  `hello-world-pico` greeting on a laptop. Descriptor:
  [`labs/hello-pico/metadata.yaml`](../../../labs/hello-pico/metadata.yaml).
- [Hello Pico on Kubernetes](../../../labs/hello-pico-on-kubernetes/)
  — the first runnable Crossplane lab. Installs Crossplane on a local
  minikube cluster, declares an `XHelloWorldPico` XRD, registers a
  pipeline-mode Composition, and creates one Composite Resource that
  reconciles into a Kubernetes `Job` printing `Hello, Pico!` from inside
  the cluster. Descriptor:
  [`labs/hello-pico-on-kubernetes/metadata.yaml`](../../../labs/hello-pico-on-kubernetes/metadata.yaml).

## Authoring course-scoped labs

Course-scoped labs live in this directory and follow the shared lab
template. Reuse a repository-root lab when the same lab is useful for more
than one course.
